### What I implemented
In `crates/bridge-a2a-inbound/src/server.rs`:
- `FoldedSnapshot { snap, events }` — `fold_or_typed_snapshot` now returns both from the ONE `journal_fold_inputs` read (previously discarded `events` in the ineligible-fallback branch and returned only `snap` always).
- `rich_snapshot_frames(snap, events, cursor)` — merges `snapshot_frames(snap, None)` (unfiltered node frames) with `fold_rich_frames(events)`, sorts by seq, then cursor-filters ONCE over the combined list.
- `fold_rich_frames(events)` — folds `Plan`/`ToolCall`/`ToolCallUpdate` journal rows: keeps only the latest `Plan`; per `tool_call_id`, merges `ToolCall` (base) + `ToolCallUpdate` (sparse patch, `Some` replaces incl. empty, `None` = untouched) into current state, emitting one `FrameKind::ToolCall` at the last-applied seq if a base existed, else an orphan `FrameKind::ToolCallUpdate`. Reuses `reattach::frame_from_orch`.
- Swapped both reattach call sites — `terminal_sse_response` (now takes `events` too) and `working_sse_response` — from `snapshot_frames` to `rich_snapshot_frames`, preserving the `SnapshotComplete` sentinel (re-derived from the merged last frame) and the `dedup_floor`/`cut_seq` logic unchanged.

In `crates/bridge-a2a-inbound/src/reattach.rs`:
